implementation: IFX SLE78 Gemalto cryptographic library for IDCore 30 rev B
description: IDCore 30 rev B is a highly secured smartcard platform compliant with Javacard 2.2.2, Global Platform 2.1.1 & 2.2 Amendment D standards, designed to operate with Infineon SLE78 chip family. The library implements TDEA, AES, AES-CMAC, SHA1-224-256-384-512, RSA, RSA CRT, ECDSA, ECC CDH, SP800-108 KDF and SP800-90A DRBG.
